item.title: Gakuen Counselor
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Puchi Ankh
  • 発売日: 2002-10-04
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: 学園カウンセラー
  • 英語名: Gakuen Counselor

あらすじ

Main character lives with his father, mother-in-law and sister. One day his father is asked to become a masked counselor at a prestigious school with his children allowed to study there in exchange. However, father has urgent business overseas leaving protagonist to play the role of masked counselor of all these cute school girls including his sister.
